dimensions.name: AWAY_IS_FBS
dimensions.comment: True when the away side is an FBS program.

dimensions.name: GAME_DATETIME
dimensions.comment: Full timestamp including kickoff time, in US EASTERN time (the shared display convention). Same instant as the warehouse's UTC column; the offset in the value shows -0400 or -0500.

dimensions.name: GAME_STATUS
dimensions.comment: The source's own status label: 'pre' scheduled, 'post' completed; a live value could appear mid-load. Use is_completed to separate played from upcoming, never this string.

dimensions.name: IS_COMPLETED
dimensions.comment: True for played games, false for scheduled ones. This flag, not the date and not the status string, is the definition of upcoming.

dimensions.name: IS_POSTSEASON
dimensions.comment: True for bowls and the College Football Playoff (the source marks them week 999). One known upstream mislabel: the Jan 2025 Gator Bowl carries week 1.

dimensions.name: SEASON
dimensions.comment: College football season, 2024 through 2026. A season's January games (bowls, CFP) belong to the prior year's season. 2026 is the only season with unplayed games, so schedule questions mean 2026.

dimensions.name: WEEK
dimensions.comment: Week within the season, 1-16 for the regular calendar. WEEK 999 IS NOT A WEEK: it marks bowls and the College Football Playoff. Filter is_postseason instead of comparing against 999.

dimensions.name: WENT_TO_OVERTIME
dimensions.comment: True for completed games that needed overtime. Always false on scheduled rows.

dimensions.name: HOME_COLLEGE
dimensions.comment: The home team's institution, e.g. 'Ohio State'. What a person means by the team.

dimensions.name: HOME_IS_FBS
dimensions.comment: True when the home side is an FBS program. The slate includes FCS opponents; league questions usually mean FBS.

dimensions.name: HOME_TEAM_FULL_NAME
dimensions.comment: Institution plus mascot, e.g. 'Ohio State Buckeyes'.

metrics.name: GAMES_COUNT
metrics.comment: Number of games. Grain is one row per GAME, not per team-game, so this counts games directly with no doubling.

metrics.name: REMAINING_GAMES
metrics.comment: Games still to be played. All of them are 2026 games.
